notes: Saphnelo subcutaneous self-administration (once-weekly 120 mg autoinjector 'SAPHNELO Pen' and pre-filled syringe) was announced approved in the US by AstraZeneca on April 27, 2026 (astrazeneca.com press release; no launch date given). The Access 360 HCP guide (US-109169 4/26) states for Pen/PFS that 'Patient will receive SAPHNELO via an SPP' and 'SPP delivers SAPHNELO to patient's home', with ASPN Pharmacies (non-dispensing) triaging the prescription to the appropriate SPP; the same eight-pharmacy SPP list applies to IV and SC and no exclusive/limited language is used. Hub: AstraZeneca Access 360, 1-866-SAPHNELO (1-866-727-4635), www.MyAccess360.com. Self-administered SC product dispensed by specialty pharmacy: not buy-and-bill. Not on the TRICARE Oct 2026 LDD list.
